NONE: › used to refer to a rhythm (= pattern of words) used in poetry, in which each short syllable that is not stressed is followed by a long or stressed syllable
（詩歌）短長格的；抑揚格的（詩歌的韻律模式，短促的非重讀音節後跟有長的或重讀的音節）

example: Most of Shakespeare's verse is written in iambic pentameter (= rhythm with each line made of five iambic pairs).
莎士比亞的大部分詩歌都是以抑揚格五音步寫成的，每行詩都由五個抑揚格組成。
